title: SQLite WAL concorrencia
body:
# SQLite WAL concorrencia

SQLite WAL permite leitores simultaneos durante uma escrita. WAL nao transforma SQLite em banco com varios escritores concorrentes. Use busy_timeout e transacoes curtas.

Related: [[concepts/mcp.md]]

title: OAuth Google acesso negado
body:
# OAuth Google acesso negado

Google OAuth retorna access_denied quando o app externo esta em teste e o usuario nao foi adicionado aos test users. Cadastre o usuario na tela de consentimento.

title: Estoque por lote FEFO
body:
# Estoque por lote FEFO

O estoque de medicamentos deve consumir primeiro o lote com vencimento mais proximo, estrategia FEFO. FIFO considera entrada e nao necessariamente validade.

title: Idempotency payment retry
body:
# Idempotency payment retry

Payment retries must reuse an idempotency key for the same purchase. Store the request key and response in the same database transaction to prevent duplicate charges.

title: Transactional outbox delivery
body:
# Transactional outbox delivery

Transactional outbox commits an event and the business change in one transaction. A separate publisher retries delivery. Consumers deduplicate messages because delivery is at least once.

title: Backup recuperavel
body:
# Backup recuperavel

Backup so e validado depois de restauracao em ambiente isolado e verificacao de integridade. Copiar um arquivo aberto sem snapshot pode produzir backup inconsistente.

title: Battle replay persisted attempts
body:
# Battle replay persisted attempts

Battle replay reads the stored attempt snapshot and ordered persisted events. Never recalculate combat with current character stats because balancing may have changed after the battle.

title: Paginacao cursor ordenacao
body:
# Paginacao cursor ordenacao

Paginacao por cursor usa ordenacao estavel com timestamp e identificador unico como desempate. Offset pode repetir ou omitir registros quando novas linhas sao inseridas.

title: Secrets redaction before capture
body:
# Secrets redaction before capture

Redact API keys, bearer tokens, cookies and credentials before writing memory or transport queues. Sanitizing only when displaying search results is too late.

title: Protected branch contribution
body:
# Protected branch contribution

External contributions use forks and pull requests. Protect main against force pushes and deletion. Require successful CI checks before merging; required reviews need another eligible reviewer.

title: MCP startup lazy indexing
body:
# MCP startup lazy indexing

MCP initialize and tools/list must return before expensive indexing. Defer loading a large vault until the first retrieval call and reuse a persistent SQLite connection.

Related: [[concepts/wal.md]]

title: Cache TTL invalidation
body:
# Cache TTL invalidation

Cache entries have an expiry time called TTL. Evict an entry when its source document changes, even before TTL ends. A stale cached answer can contradict the current source.
